notes: Timeline view polish. (1) Text position fix: the position buttons put text into free-position mode (block anchored by its CENTRE), so 'left'/'right' pushed wide text off the preview. They now use the in-bounds flex snap (clear textX/textY), matching how the render (Caption.tsx) lays out non-free text — text stays on-board. In-memory model kept in sync so re-renders don't revert. (2) Custom colour: added an extra swatch after the presets that opens the OS colour picker for any colour. (3) Column separation: the Timeline editor's left (Content) and right (properties) columns are now distinct CapCut-style panels (card background, border, rounded) so the three areas read as separate blocks. (4) Localisation: confirmed all Timeline-editor text is EN+JA; localised the position-button tooltips and added the custom-colour label.
